description: Agent Energy: submit an energy supply contract and what was agreed before signing: the agreed terms with the supplier, term in months, rate with its unit, rate type (fixed, variable or indexed), exit fee and its basis (none, flat or per remaining month), whether it renews by itself and onto which rate type, notice days, minimum usage (0 for none), monthly fee, start date and where the agreed terms come from; and the contract with the same terms and its text as written, read for wording about a variable rate, automatic renewal, exit fees and minimum usage. The signed report gives every term on both sides as aligned, conflicts, differs, not_agreed, not_in_contract, unit_differs or unread, with the exit fee counted as what leaving one month in would cost, the contract wording found, and counts them, and names a conflict: another supplier, term or rate type, a higher rate, exit fee, minimum usage or monthly fee, an automatic renewal no one agreed and contract wording that contradicts its own stated terms; then a lower rate or fee, another renewal rate type, a longer notice, a dropped renewal and another start date, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A term only one side states, units that differ and a renewal with no stated rate leave the contract unchecked. This reads one supply contract against the agreement: two versions of one text compared clause by clause are wever_contract-diff-check, one contract summarized is wever_contract-brief, a renewal notice is wever_renewal-notice-check and two versions of terms in force are wever_terms-change-check. Verdict energy_contract_conflicts, energy_contract_partial, energy_contract_unchecked or energy_contract_aligned. POST /api/energy-contract-check. Reads the energy records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Energy reads an energy customer’s own records and recomputes what they claim: the rate plan billed against the plan quoted, a solar or PPA proposal’s production and savings against its stated assumptions, a supply contract against what was agreed, a charging session against the posted price, a carbon credit or certificate claim against its retirement records, a utility bill against its tariff and usage, a commercial demand charge against interval usage and the tariff’s demand rules, and an equipment efficiency or savings claim against its rating and baseline. Beside it, wever_invoice-check reads any invoice against the job it belongs to and wever_fee-evidence-check a fee schedule against a quote or invoice, while an energy check recomputes energy charges from rates, usage and the tariff’s own rules; wever_contract-diff-check compares two versions of one text, while the contract check reads the signed contract against what was agreed; and wever_environmental-evidence-check reads sustainability claims against offered evidence, while the carbon claim check reads the retirement records behind one claim. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-energy-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-energy/.
